about: The detection baseline (docs/STANDARDS.md §5, M0.2): the problems planted in tests/fixtures/baseline-app and how far EAOS finds each, in the golden trial's check (the app run, no assistant). 'found' is what the last recorded check reached: card (a fix card names it), finding (an engine or a screen recorded it, no card), missed. tools/detection_baseline.py refuses a check that finds any of them less; --record writes what a check found after it found more. tests/fixtures/baseline-clean is its clean twin (M6.0): the same app done right, on which no layer finding may appear. 'must_stay' lists what is planted to stay unfound (an example, a placeholder, the program's own configuration): a check that finds any of them, as a finding or a card, is refused too.
